dbc (the DB2 tables), maps, vmaps, cameras and gt made from your client on the phone (an hour or more), pathfinding (mmaps) optional (hours); or imported from a computer as a zip.
LegionCore\'s connection patcher on your Wow-64.exe: the portal takes a plain host, the Battle.net key and certificate are this realm\'s, no version check. Done on the phone; no download.
An e-mail (any you like) and a password, in the realm\'s own login database. The first one is an administrator and logs in by itself.

Whether the Legion client runs on this phone\'s Box64 is untested anywhere: no report exists of a 7.x client on Android (box64 issue #3061). If the game shows a black window and closes, that\'s it, and the realm still plays from a PC on this Wi-Fi.

On a PC on the same Wi-Fi with a 7.3.5 (26972) client patched by LegionCore's connection patcher (with this realm's certificate bundle in C:\ProgramData\Blizzard Entertainment\Battle.net\Cache), set

SET portal "%1$s"

in WTF\Config.wtf, start Wow-64_Patched.exe and log in with one of the realm's accounts.
Put back or check any part of Legion, or remove all of it. The other games and their realms aren\'t touched.

World of Warcraft: Legion (7.3.5) on the phone against your own local realm: LegionCore 7.3.5 (The Legion Preservation Project, GPL-2.0, open source), with solo scaling (Solocraft) for one player. The realm is yours: no outside server, no account anywhere else.
The client is yours: World of Warcraft 7.3.5, build 26972, 64-bit, the only one the realm accepts. Its Wow-64.exe is patched by LegionCore\'s connection patcher to connect to a realm of your own.

Legion lives in its own folder (files/felsong) with its own MariaDB (port 3312), databases (auth, characters, world, hotfixes), Battle.net server (1119, 8081), world server (8095, 8096), Windows, accounts, saved login, settings, logs and backups. Nothing of the other games is read or written.
Not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment or The Legion Preservation Project. Playing on a private server is against Blizzard\'s terms of use.
Legion\'s accounts and characters, saved in its own folder (the last six). Made by themselves before an update or a database reset.

Your own copy of the Legion 7.3.5 client, build 26972, 64-bit (40–67 GB): pick its folder (the one with Wow-64.exe, .build.info and Data in it), or a zip of it. Move it onto the phone first: the app copies it into Legion\'s own folder and checks the build it says it is.

The app can\'t download the client: Blizzard serves no 7.x client (its CDN drops a build within weeks of the next; 26972 was replaced in 2018), and every 26972 download found online is a third party\'s copy, not Blizzard\'s.

The world server needs dbc (DB2 tables) and maps from your client; vmaps add line of sight, cameras the flyby scenes, gt the game tables, and mmaps pathfinding, which creatures need to move well (hours on a phone). Made on the phone with the realm\'s own tools.

Much faster than the phone, pathfinding included: with LegionCore\'s extractors of this same version (the package\'s, or built from the pinned commit) run on a copy of your client, zip the dbc, maps, vmaps, mmaps, cameras and gt folders and import the zip here. Every file is checked by its header before anything is replaced.

LegionCore\'s connection patcher makes Wow-64_Patched.exe beside your Wow-64.exe (the original stays) and the Battle.net certificate bundle the patched program trusts. The game runs the patched program.
Done, from the Wow-64.exe that\'s in
Creatures and NPCs walk around walls. Takes hours on a phone; the game plays without it.

Legion\'s own accounts, apart from the other realms\'. Legion logs in with an e-mail and a password; any e-mail you like works here, nothing is sent anywhere. The database starts by itself for this if the realm is stopped.
E-mail: letters, digits, dots and one @, up to 64. Password: up to 16 characters, no spaces or quotes.
That won\'t do as an e-mail: letters, digits, dots and one @, up to 64.
That password won\'t do: up to 16 characters, no spaces or quotes.
There\'s an account with that e-mail already.
LegionCore\'s own settings, taken at the realm\'s next start.
Solocraft, built into LegionCore: dungeons and raids scale your stats by how many players they\'re made for and how many are in. The realm is yours: play it as you like.
Pick what to check or put back. Only Legion\'s folder is touched; staging left by a step that stopped is cleaned up every time.
